items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: George Estolle sat me right in the middle of the men because it was a featured number

ctx.x: then at that time, they were paying ... oh yes, there is a little thing you should know about this -- when I got ready to record it, as I told you, I was pretty cocky -- and I was always at the studio, like they didn't use the term 'black' then, you know, I was always the only 'colored' musician, as they said, there.

Now, when we got ready to do this thing, that's when they would ... it must have been like 4 or 5 pages of music, you know. But musically, I always had a fantastic memory, you know, almost photo-full of static -- if I could -- if I read it a couple or 3 times, you know, I really had it, and so this particular day, you know, this is when you record everything together on the big soundstage at MGM, and there must have been at least 45 musicians. And George Estolle sat me right in the middle of the men because it…
